mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0019.retrieveRequestMasterId */ sq_tb_pay_calc_exec_n.nextval AS payroll_calculation_exec_id FROM dual
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAYP0019.insertRetroactivePayCalcExec */ INTO tb_pay_calc_exec_n ( payroll_calculation_exec_id , payroll_type_code , basis_date , payroll_calculation_set_id , confirm_flag , retroactive_flag , retroactive_pay_start_yyyymm , retroactive_payroll_end_yyyymm , creation_date , creation_user_id ) SELECT #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{payrollTypeCode} , to_date(a.end_yyyymmdd ,'yyyymmdd') , #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_calculation_set_id */ , 'N' /* confirm_flag */ , 'Y' /* retroactive_flag */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{retroactiveStartMonth}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM') , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{retroactiveEndMonth}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM') , SYSDATE , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n a WHERE a.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND a.payroll_calc_period_value = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM')
mapper.select: WITH gr AS ( SELECT /* LGVPAYP0019.retrievePayrollRunSectionList*/ lgvpay_common_pkg.get_calc_var_value(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}, 'PAYROLL_RUN_GROUP_COUNT', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmdd')) AS cnt FROM dual ) , pr AS ( SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)/gr.cnt) AS cnt FROM tb_pay_calc_set_target_per_n a , gr WHERE a.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) , cp AS ( SELECT a.payroll_calculation_period_id FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n a WHERE a.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND a.payroll_calc_period_value = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMM') ) , per_list AS ( SELECT a.employee_no , pr.cnt FROM tb_pay_calc_set_target_per_n a , pr WHERE a.payroll_calculation_set_id = #{calculationSetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY employee_no ) SELECT rs.start_employee_no , rs.end_employee_no , cp.payroll_calculation_period_id , #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS payroll_calculation_exec_id FROM ( SELECT group_name , MIN(employee_no) AS start_employee_no , MAX(employee_no) AS end_employee_no FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM row_no, a.employee_no, CEIL(ROWNUM/DECODE(NVl(a.cnt, 0), 0, 1, a.cnt)) AS group_name FROM per_list a ) GROUP BY group_name ) rs , cp
